tool_needed.instructions: Can this request be answered from supplied text and general knowledge alone, or must the assistant access external/current/stored data, an application, or a device action?

criteria.tool: Requires current or stored data, a user resource, an application, a device, or an external action.
criteria.no_tool: Can be completed entirely from supplied text and general knowledge with no external access or action.

domain.instructions: Choose the single best request domain, or compound when several domains are required.

criteria.conversation: Answer, explain, rewrite, summarize supplied text, translate, or brainstorm without external data.
criteria.calendar: Read, create, change, cancel, or search calendar events, agendas, and free time.
criteria.reminders: Read, search, create, change, complete, or delete reminders and tasks.
criteria.email: Read, search, summarize, draft, reply to, archive, or send email.
criteria.messages: Read or send text messages; search conversations; look up contacts; place calls.
criteria.files: Read, find, list, create, move, organize, convert, or delete files, folders, and documents.
criteria.notes_memory: Read, search, create, append, remember, recall, or forget notes and personal memory.
criteria.system: Read or control device state, settings, network, clipboard, screen, or hardware.
criteria.apps_media: Open, quit, switch, or control applications, windows, music, and media.
criteria.web_data: Search or fetch the web; weather, stocks, news, sports, time, definitions, math, and conversions.
criteria.travel: Find places, directions, traffic, travel time, local events, flights, and transit.
criteria.compound: The request requires two or more different domains or dependent tool steps.

operation.instructions: Choose the primary requested operation, or compound when several operations are required.

criteria.converse: Answer, explain, rewrite, translate, summarize supplied text, or brainstorm with no tool.
criteria.read: Read, summarize, or report current, external, device, or stored information.
criteria.search: Find, search, or look up an item, source, record, place, or conversation.
criteria.create: Create or add a new event, reminder, note, folder, file, capture, or stored fact.
criteria.update: Change, move, archive, complete, mark, organize, or edit an existing item.
criteria.delete: Delete, trash, cancel, clear, remove, or forget an existing item.
criteria.send: Send, draft, reply, forward, call, or communicate something to another person.
criteria.control: Operate a device, application, setting, window, network, or media playback.
criteria.calculate: Calculate arithmetic or convert numeric units, values, or currency.
criteria.compound: The request requires several different operations or dependent steps.
